This supplement **is** the existing methods notebooks. Notebooks stay in
`Rmd/` so `root=` paths keep working; this file only lists and links them.
Figures for the contract report are knitted in
[`06.0_report.Rmd`](06.0_report.Rmd) — do not duplicate them here.

Knit order is in [`README.md`](README.md) and in the section below.

# Notebooks

## [`01_screening.Rmd`](01_screening.Rmd) — stock selection / SAG

Week 1 screening of Category 1 candidates: SAG status, advice vs catch,
and local WGCSE `FLStock` vs SAG. Confirms the case-study list.

Writes `data/results/01_screening.RData` (`screening`: stocks, inventory,
SAG extracts, cleaned `oms`).

## [`02.0_condition_om.Rmd`](02.0_condition_om.Rmd) — Operating Model / six SRR scenarios

Builds the Operating Models used by the open- and closed-loop runs: load
and clean WGCSE stocks, fit six SRR scenarios (BH / Ricker × unconstrained,
FishLife steepness, \(R_0\) fixed), add ICES benchmarks, and simulate
recruitment deviations (the observed productivity history used in the
historical backtest).

Writes `data/om/oms.RData`, `data/om/sag.RData`, `data/om/eqls.RData`,
and `data/om/recDevs.RData`.

## [`02.1_lterm_eq.Rmd`](02.1_lterm_eq.Rmd) — long-term \(F_{\mathrm{MSY}}\) gate

**Required** before any `04.*` backtest. 50-year deterministic `fwd` at
FLBRP \(F_{\mathrm{MSY}}\) versus `refpts(eq)["msy",]` via `ltermEq` /
`ltermPass`. Knit after `02.0`. `require_om_gate()` stops if any stock
fails. Full trajectories live here; `02.2` keeps compact diagnostics.

Writes `data/results/03.3_lterm_eq.RData` (`lterm_eq`).

## [`02.2_dynamics.Rmd`](02.2_dynamics.Rmd) — dynamics / realised status

**Required** diagnostics: historical dynamics, SPR0, process error,
realised status, and the compact `fwd` vs FLBRP check. Knit after `02.0`.

Writes diagnostics under `data/interim/03.0_om/` and
`data/results/03.0_om.RData` (`oms`, `eqs`, realised-status tables,
`lterm`).

## [`04.1_openLoop.Rmd`](04.1_openLoop.Rmd) / [`04.2_closedLoop.Rmd`](04.2_closedLoop.Rmd) — generic backtest

Same Operating Models; two harvest policies. `04.1` is open-loop `fwd` at
ICES \(F_{\mathrm{target}}\). `04.2` is closed-loop `hcrICES`. Both **stop**
if `02.1` / `02.2` have not passed (`require_om_gate()` in `R/om.R`).
Historical runs keep year-specific \(M\), mass and maturity and replay
recruitment residuals (observed productivity).

Writes `data/results/03.1_openLoop.RData`, `03.2_closedLoop.RData`.

## [`04.3_rebuild.Rmd`](04.3_rebuild.Rmd) — 20-year Future

From historical and closed-loop terminal states, `fwdWindow` 20 years with
**mean** recruitment. That switches off the observed residual history.

Writes `data/results/04.3_rebuild.RData`.

## [`05.0_digest.Rmd`](05.0_digest.Rmd) — all-stock digest

Terminal status for every gated stock. Use this to choose case studies.

## [`06.1_TwoStocks.Rmd`](06.1_TwoStocks.Rmd) — case studies (funders)

Irish Sea whiting and Celtic Sea cod. Funder take-home first.

## [`06.2_generic.Rmd`](06.2_generic.Rmd) — generic OM, scn2

Same question and figure set as `06.1`, for the remaining stocks on a generic **scn2** OM. Celtic Sea cod and Irish Sea whiting are in `06.1`.

## [`06.0_report.Rmd`](06.0_report.Rmd) — contract report

Loads `data/om` and `data/results` only. Does not re-run simulations.

# Knit order

```
01_screening.Rmd
02.0_condition_om.Rmd
        ├── 02.1_lterm_eq.Rmd          (required gate)
        └── 02.2_dynamics.Rmd          (required diagnostics)
04.1_openLoop.Rmd          }  generic FLStock backtest
04.2_closedLoop.Rmd        }
        └── 04.3_rebuild.Rmd
05.0_digest.Rmd                        (all stocks)
06.1_TwoStocks.Rmd                  (two case studies — funder summary)
06.2_generic.Rmd                            (generic OM — scn2)
06.0_report.Rmd

Optional: 04.4_closedLoop_sam.Rmd, 07_srr_internal_external.Rmd
```

`04.1` and `04.2` share the OM and differ only in harvest policy.
`02.1` / `02.2` are a hard stop. Knit `00_supplement.Rmd` anytime; it is
an index.

## Notes

Generic FLR helpers:

- **FLBacktest** — `hcrICES`, `hcrParams`, `cleanStock`, `openloop_start`,
  `project_hcr`, `years_to`, `ltermEq`, `ltermPass`, `backtest` (`tryIt = FALSE`)
- **FLfse** / **stockassessment** — `FLR_SAM`, `SAM2FLStock` (`04.4` only)
- **ggplotFL** — `plot`, `geom_flpar_lab`
- **icesdata** — `eql`, `addBenchmark`, `getSAG`, `b0dyn`, `processError`

Application-only: `R/plot_theme.R`, `data/reference/stocks.csv`,
`R/loadStocks.R`, `R/om.R` (`load_om`, `require_om_gate`), `R/advice_sheets.R`.
See [`docs/FLR_methods.md`](../docs/FLR_methods.md).

Code: [github.com/laurieKell/backtest-ices](https://github.com/laurieKell/backtest-ices);
engine: [github.com/laurieKell/FLBacktest](https://github.com/laurieKell/FLBacktest).
Pipeline: `Rscript scripts/run_pipeline.R`.
